# Hearthstone & Co. Workforce Solutions

> Veteran-owned and woman-owned healthcare staffing company in Katy, Texas, serving Greater Houston. Supplies credentialed RNs, LVNs and CNAs to healthcare facilities on a W-2 employment model.

Last updated: October 23, 2026

## What Hearthstone is

- Legal name: Hearthstone & Co. Workforce Solutions LLC
- Business type: Healthcare staffing company (workforce solutions)
- Location: Katy, TX (Greater Houston). Phone (713) 938-3989
- Parent: A subsidiary of The Shiylohe Collective
- Founder and CEO: Renaye Mullings, U.S. Army veteran
- Tagline: Built for the Floor. Ready for Scale.

## Who Hearthstone staffs

- Registered Nurses (RN)
- Licensed Vocational Nurses (LVN)
- Certified Nursing Assistants (CNA)

Clinicians are W-2 employees of Hearthstone, paid weekly.

## Who Hearthstone serves

Skilled nursing facilities, assisted living communities, memory care, behavioral health facilities, hospitals, outpatient clinics, home health and other healthcare organizations that need supplemental clinical staffing.

## How facilities engage

- Request staffing: https://hearthstoneandco.com/request-staffing
- Email: facilities@hearthstoneandco.com
- General inquiries: hello@hearthstoneandco.com
- Placement target: Hearthstone aims to fill any role within 36 to 72 hours after the request is confirmed. This is a target, not a guarantee.
- Staffing arrangements include per diem, contract, travel and temp-to-hire placements.

## Service area

Harris County, Fort Bend County and Montgomery County, Texas, including Houston, Katy, Sugar Land, Cypress, The Woodlands, Spring, Pearland and Missouri City.

## Screening and credentialing

Background screening through Checkr (FACIS Level 3) and drug screening. Active license verification and federal exclusion checks (OIG and SAM). Additional documentation is completed to each facility's requirements. More detail: https://hearthstoneandco.com/compliance-credentialing

## Certifications and registrations

- SBA-Certified Veteran-Owned Small Business (VOSB) and Woman-Owned Small Business (WOSB)
- NaVOBA-certified Veteran's Business Enterprise (VBE), certificate 202600352V, valid October 20, 2026 to October 20, 2029
- SAM.gov registered. UEI: SVAZQG49VUH7. CAGE: 1ZPE9
- NAICS: 561320 (Temporary Help Services), 561311 (Employment Placement Agencies)
- Listed in the Texas Women Veterans Registry (City of Houston)
- Texas HUB certification: application in progress (not yet certified)

Documents: https://hearthstoneandco.com/certifications

## Hours

Monday to Friday 8 AM to 6 PM, Saturday 9 AM to 5 PM, Sunday closed (Central Time).
